router.credit: current action token through current TBPTT chunk end, including current target; no past-token loss or future chunks
router.gradient: CE mean + sum_t,k(stopgrad(loss_to_go_t - b_old * remaining_targets_t) * logp_tk)/chunk_targets, then chunk_targets/group_targets weighting
router.baseline_commit: EMA per-token CE beta .99, updated after each chunk using detached loss; candidate state commits only after successful optimizer group

budget.complete_document_rule: largest complete group prefix <= candidate; actual must be >=250K; lowest candidate may be ineligible after rounding, report insufficient rather than pretend exact budget

initialization: forked same seed for common M0/M1/M2 components; new state and state-router modules independent seed

precision_policy.overflow: FP32 nonfinite loss/gradient fails before optimizer.step; restore RNG and discard group baseline/counters; no blind retries. Post-step nonfinite params invalidate run and are not checkpointed.

gradient_horizon.state_and_kv: retain graph within chunk, detach both after backward; numeric carry until document end
gradient_horizon.T0: standard causal self-attention includes current input Token, no future Token; all layer KV detached at each chunk boundary
gradient_horizon.optimizer_group: sum chunk sum-CE / total valid group targets, PG uses same denominator; one step per eight complete documents
gradient_horizon.state_update: h_before and output u; functional replacement; second same-cell call reads newly updated state

ablations.cell_off: replace CellCore State input by zero; preserve state updates and Router
ablations.router_off: zero W_S*s term only; M2 only
ablations.recurrence_off: replace GRU old-state argument by zero, preserve h_before/u and write
ablations.all_off: cell_off + router_off + recurrence_off; no claim distinct predictive content beyond cell_off+router_off
ablations.write_off: keep zero initial State by preventing all updates
ablations.reset_chunk: reset numerical State at chunk starts; not KV
ablations.shuffle: fixed cyclic shift by one of CellCore-read State indices only; storage, writes and Router State mapping unchanged; probes CellCore identity binding only

holdout_policy: separate dataset validation subset used for development selection; independent holdout not loaded
